card.text: M47 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 468 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_2422: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 468.27206923 pc (16th to 84th percentile 468 to 469)

sources.quote: Messier 47, also known as NGC 2478 is an open cluster in the southern constellation of Puppis.

introduction.text: M47 is drawn as 510 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
